audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows gave Gragas or Skill where the page's own text gives them to you: whys[1] and whys[2] say your Q plus a banked Indestructible out-trade him, whys[4] says the Realm 1v1 is yours, yet the chart read Gragas / Gragas / Skill on those rows and Gragas at first item where whys[5] says you burn through his damage reduction.
audit.why: The packet chart is Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Mordekaiser / Skill / Gragas, and the mirror has already flipped rows 1, 2, 4 and 5 to it. A 51.09% win rate over 458 games does not sit under a chart that gives Gragas four of seven rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 4 and 5 flipped as one atomic group in both layers, ratings raised to 7/10 on the three Mordekaiser rows, and phases[3].why / phases[5].why rewritten so the reason matches the side.

audit.why: Spike timings hold: Q+W at 2-3 before his sustain matters, Realm of Death at 6, magic pen at first item burning through the Drunken Rage window, and Gragas reclaiming it at 2+ items on burst and knockback disengage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's own defect line: the full layer never names a single Gragas ability, calling everything 'his slam', 'his escape', 'his Q puddle'. No cooldowns anywhere. And the page states four times that Gragas heals by standing in his Q barrel pool.
audit.why: Barrel Roll's cooldown is 10/9/8/7/6, Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 — a flat 14 seconds at rank 1 and still 12 maxed, which is the whole reason it is both his engage and his only exit. Riot's Barrel Roll text has no heal in it: the sustain is Happy Hour, which heals him periodically on skill use, so it is cast frequency you are fighting, not a puddle you can walk out of. Drunken Rage is also an auto reset with a 1-second sip as the tell.
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, phases[3].why and phases[5].why; the auto-reset tell into dontsFull[0].d; Happy Hour and Grievous Wounds into dontsFull[1].d, phases[5].why and wants.foe[0].
sources: enemyKit Gragas Q/W/E cooldowns and text

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization never mentions anti-heal against a champion whose passive heals him on every skill cast.
audit.why: Happy Hour is flagged as the anti-heal target for this matchup and the page builds Liandry's into Riftmaker with no Grievous Wounds timing named, which is precisely the extended trade Gragas is built to survive.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds named as the condition for closing the grind, in phases[5].why and dontsFull[1].d.

edits.after: Q ranks hit hard, but Body Slam is only 14s and resets his spacing — land Death's Grasp first or he simply dashes out of the aura.

edits.after: - Body Slam (E): 14s down to 12s — his engage and his only exit. R him inside it. - Barrel Roll (Q): 10s.

edits.before: His escape. R him when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: That is Gragas's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Drunken Rage is an auto reset — the 1s sip is your cue to step out, not the hit.

notes: The 'Q barrel pool that heals him' claim is factually wrong and appears in five more places I did not have length room to fix cleanly: whys[0] ('a lone Q he just heals off'), early ('Don't trade while he's standing in his Q barrel pool — that heal undoes your poke'), mid ('drag him out of the barrel pool'), late ('his pool sustain'), and wants.you[0] ('yank Gragas out of his Q barrel pool'). Riot's Barrel Roll text is a rolling cask that explodes and slows — no heal, no lingering pool. The sustain is Happy Hour, which heals periodically on skill use. I corrected wants.foe[0] and stated the real mechanic in dontsFull[1].d and phases[5].why; the other five need a pass that reframes 'pull him out of the pool' as 'deny him casts and bring Grievous Wounds', which does not fit the same character budget as a one-line swap. Worth a follow-up. No suspect names flagged and none found. The kit file's 'grounding' flag on Mordekaiser's Q is unsupported by Riot's text, so I claimed nothing about Obliterate stopping Body Slam.
